problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone operator root finding: F:E→E satisfies ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0, and some xstar satisfies F(xstar)=0 and ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. No scalar objective or saddle representation is assumed.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact full operator evaluations: querying x returns F(x) for every call index and oracle seed. No oracle error, stochastic noise, or derivative information is supplied. The complexity counts all such evaluations with a fixed budget valid for every seed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderMonotone.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: L, H, and α are hidden parameters. The algorithm receives only E, x0, r0, and ε through Public.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderMonotone.lean: Public, Params, and spec.publicInput; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Global mixed Lipschitz–Hölder continuity: ‖F(x)−F(y)‖≤L‖x−y‖+H‖x−y‖^α, with L,H≥0 and 0<α≤1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm; no dimension bound is supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The solution-distance upper bound R is hidden. The public scale r0 satisfies 0<r0≤R but is not assumed to lower-bound the actual distance to a zero. Accuracy ε>0 is public.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual criterion must hold almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed distribution. Algorithm randomization is permitted.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HolderMonotone.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm.law and Convergence

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The output is a single point x∈E satisfying the unsquared operator residual criterion ‖F(x)‖≤ε. No particular iterate or averaging rule is required.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The underlying monotone root problem is established, but this formulation combines a mixed global Lipschitz–Hölder modulus with hidden continuity parameters and a hidden solution-radius bound, while requiring an almost-sure operator residual guarantee under a fixed oracle budget.

descriptionHtml:
Zeros of Hölder Monotone Operators

We seek a zero of a monotone operator F:E→E on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E. The operator satisfies a mixed Lipschitz–Hölder bound with constants L,H≥0 and exponent α∈(0,1]. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R>0 of a zero x⋆ of F. These regularity parameters and R are hidden from the algorithm. The oracle returns F(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E satisfying ∥F(x¯)∥≤ε almost surely under P, the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The problem is to find x⋆∈Esuch thatF(x⋆)=0. Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The algorithm receives only E, x0, a radius parameter r0, and ε, where 0<r0≤R; the parameters L,H,α,R may enter only the oracle-call budget.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Monotonicity). For every x,y∈E, ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0.

Assumption 2 (Mixed Lipschitz–Hölder continuity). For every x,y∈E, ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥+H∥x−y∥α.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance to a zero). There exists a zero x⋆ of F satisfying ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must satisfy the residual criterion ∥F(x¯)∥≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
On a finite-dimensional real inner-product space, F:E→E is monotone and satisfies ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥+H∥x−y∥α, with L,H≥0 and 0<α≤1. A zero x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, and 0<r0≤R, ε>0. The exact oracle returns F(x); the target is ∥F(x^)∥≤ε. Result (1) uses only x0,r0,ε and returns a stopped iterate deterministically; the setup imposes no algorithm restriction.

Monotone root finding under mixed Lipschitz–Hölder continuity: HolderMonotone.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) UniversalHolderMonotone (Ours) (⋆⋆) (review) O((S+log⁡ρ)[1+log⁡(Sρ)])
(2) PolyakEG-LS (Yoon et al. 2026), Thm. 3.4(12), Prop. 3.5. O(1+R2(2M/ε)2/ν+(λR/ε)2+log+(2M)1/νλε(1−ν)/ν). Pure Hölder: L=0, (M,ν)=(H,α); pure Lipschitz: H=0, (M,ν)=(L,1). (1): For L=0, α=1/2, H=R=r0=1, fixed λ, ε↓0: O(ε−2log⁡(1/ε)) instead of O(ε−4). Scope: mixed continuity. Matches parameter-free updates. At H=0, fixed L,R,r0,λ, ε↓0: O(ε−1log⁡(1/ε)) instead of O(ε−2).
(3) Fast composite extragradient (Zhang 2026), Thm. 2. OH,R,α(1+[ε−2ℓα]1/(3α−1)). Comparison: L=0, G=0, one Hölder operator, α>1/3. Parameter dependence not explicit. (1): Fixed H,R,r0, 1/3<α<1, ε↓0: exponent 1/α instead of 2/(3α−1); no knowledge of H,α. Also covers α≤1/3. (1): Stopped rather than last iterate; extra logarithm at α=1. Equations in finite dimension rather than Hilbert-space inclusions with sums of operators.
(4) Tseng splitting (Zhang 2026), Thm. 1. OH,R,α(1+[ε−2ℓα]1/α). Comparison: L=0, G=0, one Hölder operator. Parameter dependence not explicit. (1): Fixed H,R,r0,α, ε↓0: exponent 1/α instead of 2/α, up to logarithms; no knowledge of H,α. (1): Equations in finite dimension rather than Hilbert-space inclusions with sums of operators.
(5) Anchored extragradient (Yoon and Ryu 2021), Cor. 2, Sec. 2.3. O(1+LR/ε). Special case H=0; known L. (1): No knowledge of L; scope extends to mixed Lipschitz–Hölder continuity. (1): Logarithmic overhead at H=0 (also radius-guess overhead); stopped rather than last iterate.

Abbr: S=1+LR/ε+(8HRα/ε)1/α; ρ=R/r0; ℓα=1+(1−α)log+⁡(1/ε); log+⁡t=max{0,log⁡t}, with log+⁡0=0. Costs count all evaluations of F, including rejected trials. In (2), λ>0 is the initial inverse-step estimate; line-search constants are fixed at A=1/2, β=3. In (3), (4), G is the set-valued inclusion term; OH,R,α holds these parameters fixed.

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.ProbabilityMeasure
import LongTails.Template

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.HolderMonotone

open OracleTemplate

structure Public where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  x0 : E
  r0 : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.linearE Public.finiteE

structure Params extends Public where
  L : ℝ
  H : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  R : ℝ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → p.E
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid q := 0 ≤ q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.H ∧ 0 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < q.r0 ∧ q.r0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q F oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, oracle.answer k (0, x) seed = F x) ∧
    (∀ x y, 0 ≤ ⟪F x - F y, x - y⟫) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖ + q.H * ‖x - y‖ ^ q.α) ∧
    (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R)
  successful q F output P :=
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), ‖F (output ω)‖ ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.HolderMonotone
